summary: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K/A amending its prior 8-K regarding the completed merger with United Dogecoin Inc. (UDC). The merger closed on May 1, 2026, with Shuttle issuing Series B-1 Preferred Stock as consideration for UDC equity. Management later determined UDC did not meet the definition of a business under ASC 805, so the transaction is not a business combination and financial statements are not required. The amendment reclassifies the disclosure away from Item 2.01. Key uncertainties include valuation and stockholder approval timing, making this a niche acquisition with limited deal terms disclosed.
